Indented declarations INSIDE an enumerated span are covered by the outer body's hash and not listed. Orphans on the 1.1.0 side: 1050 in `hand` files, 1885 in `generated` (613 one-line); 1377 identical across the trees, 1910 rows. Total indented declarations for comparison: 8473 (4883 hand, 3590 generated).
